instruction: Treat `/home/user/Desktop/full_gui_benchmark.step` in FreeCAD 0.21.2 from `/usr/bin/freecad` and use the Path workbench to produce `/home/user/Desktop/task-20.nc` as the starting point. The stock spans Z=0 to Z=18 mm. The NC program must use millimetres and absolute positioning and contain these completed machining results: top Face machining at Z=17.5 mm with at least four full-width tracks; separate left and right pocket regions reaching Z=12.0 mm; eight through holes reaching Z=-1.0 mm at X = -70, -50, -30, -10, 10, 30, 50, 70 mm and Y = -30 mm; a closed outside Profile reaching Z=-1.0 mm; and a shallow top-face Engrave path at Z=17.0 mm. Use T1, T2, T3, and T4 for the face, pocket/profile, drilling, and engraving work respectively. Include operation comments identifying FACE, POCKET, DRILL, PROFILE, and ENGRAVE, use safe rapid moves between cutting regions, and end the program with M30.
